records.issue_text: The delete action's destroyRecord() call in embeddable-host.js.es6 has no .catch() handler (unlike save(), which uses popupAjaxError), so a failed host deletion fails silently with no user feedback
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` with no `.catch(...)` handler, unlike `save()` which explicitly `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the DELETE request fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and the UI provides no error feedback and may remain out of sync.
